title.title: Strict comparison implies Jiang–Su stability
title.subtitle: Claim: simple separable unital nuclear C*-algebras with strict comparison absorb $\mathcal Z$ (Toms–Winter)

beats.text: Three regularity properties of simple separable nuclear C*-algebras
$\mathcal Z$-stability and finite nuclear dimension were shown equivalent in 2021
Claim: strict comparison implies $\mathcal Z$-stability, so all three agree (unital case)

achievement.label: Toms–Winter conjecture
statement: A \text{ has strict comparison} \Rightarrow A \cong A \otimes \mathcal Z
achievement.context: Before: known only with conditions on the trace space or uniform property $\Gamma$
achievement.note: Also Robert–Tikuisis C1 and the unital stably finite case of Szabó's Conj. A

verify.detail: Lean: the unital comparison-to-$\mathcal Z$ step and uniform property $\Gamma$. Not (b) or (c)
verify.ourCheck: We compared the Lean scope with the claim; we did not build it

plain: Three ways to say a C*-algebra is well behaved were conjectured equal; the missing link is now claimed

voice.text: Three regularity properties of simple nuclear C star algebras.
Two were already shown equivalent, in twenty twenty one. The third?
Claimed: strict comparison implies the others, so all three agree.
